Free to Online — Initial Release

- Launches the free-to-online skill for uploading and sharing videos online without local installation.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB, with fast cloud processing (20-40s typical).
- Automatic setup: handles anonymous token creation, session management, and cloud uploads.
- User prompts matched to actions like upload, export, credits, and editing via keyword classification.
- Reliable export to 1080p MP4 format; shares downloadable links for quick access.
- Provides clear error handling, feedback, and session-based job tracking for a smooth user experience.
